config.label: Campus Parent portal base URL, e
config.description: Campus Parent portal base URL, e.g. https://campus.district.k12.example.us

config.label: Infinite Campus district app name (appName path segment from the portal URL)
config.description: Infinite Campus district app name (appName path segment from the portal URL)

config.label: Campus Parent portal username
config.description: Campus Parent portal username. Optional: leave unset to use the ContextMint Bridge browser-extension fallback.

config.label: Campus Parent portal password
config.description: Campus Parent portal password. Required only when IC_USERNAME is set.

config.label: Friendly name for the district (defaults to district appname)
config.description: Friendly name for the district (defaults to district appname)

config.label: Set to 1 to skip the ContextMint Bridge browser-extension fallback (missing creds become a hard error — useful in headless CI)
config.description: Set to 1 to skip the ContextMint Bridge browser-extension fallback (missing creds become a hard error — useful in headless CI).

config.label: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start
config.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

config.label: Absolute path for the session cache file
config.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.infinitecampus-mcp/session-<district>.json.

config.label: Absolute path of the only directory ic_download_document may write into
config.description: Absolute path of the only directory ic_download_document may write into. Defaults to ~/Downloads.

config.label: Localhost concentrator port (default 37149)
config.description: Localhost concentrator port (default 37149). On one machine every MCP shares the concentrator, so move it for ALL of them or not at all.

config.label: Bind interface (default 127
config.description: Bind interface (default 127.0.0.1; a literal IP only, anything else is ignored). Keep on loopback — it exists for ONE topology: a hosted child in its own network namespace.

config.label: Where to store the long-term fetchproxy identity keypair (default ~/
config.description: Where to store the long-term fetchproxy identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/; an absolute path only, anything else is ignored). Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller, so they can share one identity.
